# Community Rule Column 5 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 5 | **Condition:** complete

---

**5:1** And this is the-rule for the-men-of the-community who volunteer to turn from all evil and to hold-fast to all that He has commanded according-to His will: to separate

**5:2** from the-congregation-of the-men-of injustice, to be a community in Torah and in property, and submitting under the-authority-of the-sons-of Zadok, the priests who-keep

**5:3** the covenant, and under the-authority-of the-multitude-of the-men-of the-community who hold-fast to the covenant. By their authority the-decision-of the-lot shall be made regarding every matter

**5:4** of Torah, and of property, and of judgment, to practice truth together and humility,

**5:5** and righteousness, and justice, and covenant-faithfulness, and to walk humbly in all their ways. Let no man walk in the-stubbornness-of his heart

**5:6** to go-astray after his heart and his eyes and the-thoughts-of his inclination. Rather, he shall circumcise in the-community the-foreskin-of the-inclination and the stiff neck,

**5:7** to lay a foundation-of truth for Israel, for the-community-of an everlasting covenant, to atone for all who volunteer for holiness in Aaron and for a house-of truth

**5:8** in Israel, and those who join them for community. In judgment and in trial and in walking according-to all these statutes, when they enter

**5:9** the-community, everyone who enters the-council-of the-community shall enter the-covenant-of God in the-sight-of all who volunteer, and he shall take-upon himself by a binding oath

**5:10** to return to the-Torah-of Moses according-to all that He has commanded, with all his heart and with all his soul,

**5:11** to all that has been revealed from it to the-sons-of Zadok, the priests who-keep the covenant and seek His will, and to the-multitude-of the-men-of

**5:12** their covenant who volunteer together for His truth and to walk according-to His will. And he shall take-upon himself by the covenant to separate

**5:13** from all the-men-of injustice who walk in the-way-of wickedness. For these are not reckoned in His covenant, for they have not sought and they have not inquired

**5:14** after His statutes, to know the-hidden-things in which they have gone-astray, incurring-guilt, and the-revealed-things they have done with a high hand,

**5:15** arousing anger for judgment and for the-vengeance-of the-curses-of the-covenant, to execute against them great judgments unto eternal destruction without remnant.

**5:16** He shall not enter the-water to touch the-purity-of the-men-of holiness, for they will not be cleansed unless they have turned from their wickedness,

**5:17** for he is impure among all the-transgressors-of His word. And no man shall associate with him in his work or in his property, lest he burden him

**5:18** with guilty iniquity. Rather, he shall keep-far from him in every matter, for thus it is written: "From every false thing you shall keep far."

**5:19** And every man-of the-men-of the-community shall be-examined, each one by his spirit, one from another, with respect-to his understanding and his deeds in the Torah,

**5:20** according-to the-authority-of the-sons-of Aaron who volunteer in the-community to establish His covenant and to attend-to all His statutes which He commanded to do,

**5:21** and according-to the-authority-of the-multitude-of Israel who volunteer to return in the-community to His covenant.

**5:22** And they shall be enrolled in order, each before his neighbor, according-to his understanding and his deeds, so-that each man shall obey his neighbor, the junior the-senior.

**5:23** And their spirit and their deeds shall be examined year by year, to advance each one according-to his understanding and the-perfection-of his way,

**5:24** or to demote him according-to his failings. Each man shall reprove his neighbor in truth and humility and covenant-faithfulness.

**5:25** Let no man speak to his brother in anger or in complaint or with a stiff neck or in a jealous spirit-of wickedness,

**5:26** and let him not hate him in the-foreskin-of his heart, but on the-same-day he shall reprove him and shall not bear sin on-account-of him.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Hebrew text of 1QS Column 5 (Cave 1, complete). "Covenant-faithfulness" renders hesed. "Sons of Zadok" preserved as sectarian priestly designation. "Foreskin of the inclination" (orlat ha-yetser) at 5:6 is a distinctive Qumran metaphor. "The Many" (ha-rabbim) rendered as "the multitude" to preserve Hebrew sense. Citation at 5:18 is from Exodus 23:7.*
